items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: The record I made over in Barbados was done with Bucky, Major Holly, Butch Miles, Rick Wilkins on tenor, and myself, without the piano.

ctx.x: Yeah. I made a beautiful record with strings some years ago, Rick Wilkins the great arranger that used to arrange for the Boss Brass, did the arrangements for me. And it really was a nice record. And it was at the time when we would get airplay on the FM stations, so it got a lot of play.
Did you happen to work with either guitar players or piano players along the way that really helped you with understanding the chord changes and all that?
